VR.title: Xreal's new $299 AR glasses bring the big-screen experience to more people
VR.summary: Xreal launches its new $299 a01+ AR glasses in the U.S., offering a 147-inch virtual screen and lightweight design to enhance the viewing experience.

VR.title: XREAL’s First Budget AR Glasses Go on Sale Internationally, Priced at $300
VR.summary: XREAL's budget AR glasses, priced at $300, are now available internationally, expanding access to immersive technology.

VR.title: Apple Publishes Detailed Technical Specifications for Third-party Vision Pro Motion Controllers
VR.summary: Apple releases technical specifications for third-party motion controllers for its Vision Pro headset, paving the way for enhanced user experiences.

VR.title: Steam Frame Launch Nears as Valve Releases ‘Great on Frame’ Store Page
VR.summary: Valve's Steam Frame standalone headset is nearing launch, with a new store page highlighting top games for the upcoming device.

VR.title: John Carmack Reminds Microsoft He'll Guarantee $1 Million To Bring Team Beef’s Ports To VR
VR.summary: John Carmack reiterates his $1 million guarantee to Microsoft for commercializing VR ports of classic id Software games.

VR.title: VR/MR Puzzler Squingle Arcade Is Out Today On Meta Quest For Free
VR.summary: The fast-paced VR/MR puzzle game Squingle Arcade is now available for free on Meta Quest, adding to the platform's diverse offerings.

AI.title: Apple sues OpenAI for allegedly stealing hardware secrets
AI.summary: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging theft of trade secrets related to its hardware development.

AI.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-5.6 after government greenlight — and announces ‘ChatGPT Work’
AI.summary: OpenAI launches GPT-5.6 after receiving government approval, marking a significant advancement in its AI model capabilities.

AI.title: Google will now tell you if an ad was made with AI
AI.summary: Google introduces a new feature that labels ads created or edited with AI, enhancing transparency for users.

AI.title: Would you host part of an AI data center in your home?
AI.summary: Sunrun is launching a pilot program to host AI data centers in customers' homes, offering financial incentives for participation.

AI.title: Meta turns off the Instagram feature that let users make AI deepfakes of public accounts
AI.summary: Meta has disabled an Instagram feature that allowed users to create AI deepfakes using public account content following backlash.

AI.title: The ChatGPT browser is already dead
AI.summary: OpenAI is shutting down its ChatGPT Atlas browser, less than a year after its launch, as part of a broader restructuring.

NFL.title: Niners part owner agrees to purchase Seahawks
NFL.summary: A group led by Niners limited partner Vinod Khosla has agreed to purchase the Seahawks for a record $9.612 billion.

NFL.title: Commanders to retire No. 44 of HOF RB Riggins
NFL.summary: The Commanders are set to retire Hall of Famer John Riggins' No. 44, honoring his legacy over 40 years after his iconic Super Bowl run.

NFL.title: Study: NFLers die from dementia at higher rate
NFL.summary: A new study reveals NFL players are four times more likely to die from neurodegenerative diseases compared to the general population.

NFL.title: Sources: CB Douglas to sign with Commanders
NFL.summary: Free agent cornerback Rasul Douglas is reportedly signing a one-year deal with the Washington Commanders worth up to $3.8 million.

NFL.title: Clutch Vinatieri to enter Colts' Ring of Honor
NFL.summary: Kicker Adam Vinatieri, a future Hall of Famer, will be inducted into the Colts' Ring of Honor on October 18.

NFL.title: Late Cowboys' player Kneeland diagnosed with CTE
NFL.summary: Former Cowboys defensive end Marshawn Kneeland has been posthumously diagnosed with CTE, highlighting ongoing health concerns in the NFL.
